summary: Nextech's Genesis/Mega Drive action-RPG, localized as Soleil in PAL regions and later re-released through Nintendo Switch Online.

entries.title: Crusader of Centy

emulation.emulator: Nintendo Switch Online Genesis app or Genesis Plus GX
emulation.notes: Use Switch Online for current official play; use owned regional dumps only if studying localization differences.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Genesis/Mega Drive presentation with modern emulator conveniences.

primary.why: Nintendo Switch Online is the current official re-release of Crusader of Centy and is the practical primary route; the original regional cartridges remain important for localization comparison but do not add separate gameplay content.
primary.how_to_play: Play through the SEGA Genesis app with Nintendo Switch Online + Expansion Pack. Use original hardware or Genesis Plus GX with owned regional dumps only if comparing the different English localizations.

entries.remaster_caveats: This is an emulated re-release, not a remaster; regional scripts differ on original cartridges.
